models, PSE-certified

1.2: in Japan market, it seems that OMRON and MC are more popular. You
should know this better
1.3: MEANWELL is just not issuing it, gotta passively accept this

2. Please try to gather all questions together, so we can answer together.
This is more efficient.
Thank you.

Hi, Inoue,
1. About Power Supply
>From our perspective, we ONLY recommend MEANWELL models.
1.1: MEANWELL is a reputable brand, we use it for quite a long time, it is good.
1.2: Actually we do not trust or want to use any other brands unless it is famous.
In industrial applications, most after-sales problems come from the power supply.
We have to offer UNNECESSARY (because it is NOT our fault, our models are good) after-sales support, and it sometimes ruins business cooperation with our clients.
So we do not waste time on testing or using an unknown or untrusted brand.
We just stick with a ready and good solution.

In our discussion, we will NOT recommend using some untrusted power supplies, though cheap.
It will be a potential threat to long-term usage and even cooperation. 

2. How long can we rent the 4-port model for?
How about 6 months?
I guess this should be enough for your testing.
After that, if you decide to introduce our model, please keep it.
Or please return it.
How does it sound?

Thank you.

text:
Hi, Alex,
Thanks for your information.

1. As I explained before, AC3 to AC5 transition is almost done for ALL
models.
Here are the details.
1.1: for commercial models, 8 / 24 / 48 Port L2+/L3 models, AC5 is fully
ready and in normal production.
1.2: for industrial models, ALL models got AC5-ready samples.
4 / 8 port models, AC5 is fully ready and in normal production.
For 16 / 24 port models, AC5 is ready, but we are still handling AC3 stocks.
Once those stock units are sold, we will just say goodbye to AC3 for good.

That is to say, we can supply AC5 version for almost all models now.
- port counts: 8 / 24 / 48: Yes
- port types: 1G copper / SFP+ / SFP28 combinations: Not SFP28, we mainly
focus on 1G/10G.
- PoE / PoE+ vs non-PoE versions: Yes
- datasheet links are fine if available: Still, you can read the links I
shared before.

According to our engineering team, there is not much of a change regarding
WEB UI and product design.
It will be like a seamless transition, users just do not feel the change
from AC3 to AC5.

2. Indicative pricing and current lead times across the AC5 lineup.
2.1: The increasing memory price is a headache for now.
Generally, there will be a 15USD add-up to the prices for each managed
model.
This is just a general rule for your reference.
We will quote individually once we receive a specific request.
2.2: Leadtime is not a problem.
All the AC5 models mentioned above got stock materials, it usually takes
4~7 working days for less than 50 units.

3. Which models are best to promote first to our customers
Well, this is kind of easy to know.
3.1: ALL features on L2+ models are available on L3 models.
Eg: you can test a 48 port L3 model rather than 48 port L2+ model.
3.2: Commercial models are sharing the same software features as industrial
models.
Eg: you can test an 8 port industrial model rather than a 8 port commercial
model.
3.3: On top of this, some interesting models might be useful.
Fiber Optic Bypass Feature, Power Booster Feature, DI/DO/RS485 Feature,
Dual PSU and PSU monitoring feature, 90W PoE and heat dissipation design
etc.
Those features are integrated in regular models, it is like an add-on.

So, I guess just a few models will help understand our HW and SW features.

4. For COMPUTEX
Sorry, Saga is not attending it.
Maybe an online meeting is easier after some in-depth talks?

Please let me know.
Thank you.

text:
[cid:image001.png@01DCDC99.83BD71D0]




Değerli İş Ortağımız,
Ekte bulunan Baş İhracat Uyum Yöneticimiz tarafından kaleme alınan mektubu iletmekten ve 2026 yılının ilk çeyreğinde ihracat uyum adına gerçekleştirdiğimiz önemli çalışmaları paylaşmaktan memnuniyet duyuyoruz.
Bu çalışmaların ihracat kontrol uyum risklerinin yönetilmesine yardımcı olacağına ve iş ilişkilerimizin sağlıklı gelişimini destekleyeceğine inanıyoruz.
İş ortaklarımıza devam eden destekleri için teşekkür ederiz. Sorularınız varsa, lütfen bizimle iletişime geçmekten çekinmeyin.

Bilginize sunarız.
Netaş Uyum Departmanı



[cid:image002.png@01DCDC99.83BD71D0]

Dear Business Partner,

We are kindly pleased to enclose the attached letter from our Chief Export Compliance Officer (CECO) and share the important work we have done on export compliance in the first quarter of 2026.
We believe that these efforts will help manage export control compliance risks and support the healthy development of our business relationships.

We thank our business partners for their continued support. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Please be informed.

Netaş Compliance Department

Eğer bu e-postanın muhatabı değilseniz bu e-postanın ve eklerinin kopyalarını herhangi bir şekilde gönderemez, dağıtamaz ve yedekleyemezsiniz. Lütfen bu e-postayı yanlışlıkla aldıysanız, gönderene bu durumu bildiriniz ve e-posta ve ilişiğindeki belgeleri sistemden siliniz.
